Round166F.genuine_compact_class_native_energy.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (mu : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts mu] (S : Set (HeckeAdeles K))
  (Y : Set (HeckeIdeles K)) (hS : IsCompact S) (hY : IsCompact Y) :
  ∃ U,
    ∀ (b : HeckeAdeles K → ℂ),
      Function.support b ⊆ S →
        ∀ (B : ℝ),
          0 ≤ B →
            (∀ (z : HeckeAdeles K), ‖b z‖ ≤ B) →
              ∀ (a alpha s R : ℝ),
                0 ≤ a →
                  0 ≤ alpha →
                    0 ≤ s →
                      0 ≤ R →
                        have Q := QuotientGroup.mk '' Y;
                        have E := Q ∩ {x | |classLog K x| ≤ R};
                        have C := (↑U.card * B) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * (a + alpha) * R) * (1 + R ^ 2) ^ (s / 2);
                        ∫⁻ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K) in E, ENNReal.ofReal (nativeSeedDensity K a alpha s b x) ∂mu ≤
